title: Evidence
description: One observation made by one observer at one location. FROZEN (ARCHITECTURE.md 5). Evidence is never deleted or mutated; a later observation is a new record.

id.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of this record with 'id' removed.

run_id.description: Run that produced this record. Derived from the ProofScope hash, so it is stable across reruns of an unchanged tree.

proof_scope_hash.description: The proof this record is bound to. A new tree SHA yields a new hash and therefore new records; old records are never reused.

claim_type.description: What is being claimed, e.g. sdk_installed, call_version, production_version, request_text, dependency_state, file_unscanned. Resolution precedence is defined per claim_type; there is no global precedence.

observer.description: The observer channel. Closed set (ARCHITECTURE.md 3.2). Completeness depends on these channels failing independently.

repo_sha.description: Git HEAD of the scanned tree, or null when the target is not a git repository. Never substituted with another value.

path.description: Slash-separated path relative to the closure root. '.' for a repository-level claim.

line_start.description: 1-based first line of the observation, or null for a repository-level claim.

line_end.description: 1-based last line of the observation, or null for a repository-level claim.

source_hash.description: SHA-256 of the bytes of the file this observation was made in; the blob hash the fact cache and binding store are keyed on (ARCHITECTURE.md 14). For a repository-level claim, the SHA-256 of the empty string.

value.description: The observed content, shaped by claim_type. Any JSON value, including null.

provider_subject.description: The provider-side subject this observation is about, e.g. a version literal, a package name, a host. Null when the observation names no subject.

dependency_context_hash.description: The resolved dependency state this observation was made under, so an observation is never read back under a different dependency context.

derivation.description: DERIVED_AI_EVIDENCE can never alone change a candidate status or close an UNKNOWN (law L10).

confidence.description: RAW is the recall layer (text). PROVEN requires a structural or executed observation.
